fact: The Harare Internet Exchange Point (HIX), housed at the TelOne Exchange in Harare and set up with a USD 200,000 African Union grant, is operating, and POTRAZ says all internet access providers are connected to it; the document has no publication date and is placed at the October 2020 ITU forum.
The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Zimbabwe: HIXP, Harare.
